slots_and_copies.name: header_and_journal
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Word0 magic 'Payback.' decides save existence; word1 journal header (FFx8=idle, else 4x(dest_word,block_count)) decides boot replay of staging words 2..5; no slot selection

slots_and_copies.name: journal_staging
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Staging words 2..5; consumed only when word1 journal header validates (dest 6..62, count 1..4, all 4 repeats agree) at boot in FUN_08027c68; otherwise ignored

slots_and_copies.name: slot_0
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Single logical save at EEPROM words 6..63; game logical byte L at file (6+L//8)*8+(7-L%8) (reversed per 8-byte word); no generation counter or A/B selection

checksums.name: journal_header_repetition_check
checksums.formula_detail: No arithmetic checksum exists. Integrity = journal header at EEPROM word 1: driver-buffer bytes [dest_word,count] repeated 4x; valid iff 6<=dest_word<=62, 1<=count<=4 and all 4 dest copies and all 4 count copies agree (FUN_08027c68). Armed by FUN_080277a4 phase 2, cleared to FFx8 after commit/replay. Payload also protected by write read-back verify FUN_0807c698 retried 3x in FUN_0807c6f0 and by per-field validation in FUN_08028134. PACKET candidate byte file 0x37 is logical offset 0 (validated selector), not a checksum; sum8/xor8/crc32 over logical bytes (cap00 4a/c8/bc17aae5, cap01 4c/36/51b6ca45) match no stored byte and no code computes them.

io_driver_functions.notes: EEPROM init called as FUN_0807c3ac(4) at boot; selects descriptor whose +4=word count, +8=address-bit count are read by drivers; literal 4 semantics unresolved
DMA3 helper: stores src/dst/count|0x80000000 via literal-pool regs matching DMA3 0x040000D4/D8/DC, polls busy bit 0x8000
EEPROM word read: address bits MSB-first + two 1 bits DMA to 0x0D000000 (len addr_bits+3), then 0x44 halfwords back; reassembles 4 u16 (8 bytes)
EEPROM word write: 64 data bits + address bits + bits 0,1 DMA to 0x0D000000 (len addr_bits+0x43); optional write-complete poll on 0x0D000000 bit0 with 0xE4-wrap timer, abort after 0x88 ticks
Write wrapper: calls FUN_0807c538(addr,data,wait=1), returns low 16 bits
Write verifier (integrity, not arithmetic checksum): re-reads word via FUN_0807c474, compares 4 u16, returns 0 or 0x8000
Verified word write: up to 3 attempts of FUN_0807c524 write + FUN_0807c698 verify
Logical reader: byte offset/count, bound end<=0x1D0, word=(off>>3)+6, read-modify via FUN_0807c474, returns 0/0xFFFFFFFF
Direct logical writer (no journal): count 1..0x18, read-modify-write same dest word via FUN_0807c474+FUN_0807c6f0
Journalling logical writer: stage to words 2.., arm word1 with 4x(dest,count), commit to words 6.., clear word1 to FFx8; count cap 0x18 bounds txn to 4 staging words
Boot probe/recovery/creation: FUN_0807c3ac(4), magic check, journal replay, else clear word1 + FUN_08027f90 defaults + write magic
Defaults writer via FUN_08027a2c: logical 1..4, 11x24B entries at 5..268, zero flags at 269/308/347/386/425; then non-save hardware init
Load/validate/repair via FUN_08027b6c reads and FUN_080277a4 repairs; sole reader caller; entry point
Menu: on confirm journalling-writes 1 byte at logical 0 via FUN_080277a4; rest is text/sprite rendering, no EEPROM access
